phase5_preprocessing_mismatch.issue: W04b — train/evaluation preprocessing mismatch in run_phase5_v3.py
phase5_preprocessing_mismatch.location: run_phase5_v3.py lines 287-295 (fl_fit call) and line 291 (X_bp_pp pre-computation)
phase5_preprocessing_mismatch.description: fl_fit is called with raw X_bp (unscaled, unimputed). Inside fl_fit, LogisticClient trains local SGD on raw X_bp. However, evaluation uses predict_pp(w, X_bp_pp) and fast_metrics(w, X_bp_pp, Y_bp) where X_bp_pp = _scl_bp.transform(_imp_bp.transform(X_bp)) is globally pre-processed. Training weights are therefore on a different feature scale than the scale on which they are evaluated.
phase5_preprocessing_mismatch.effect_under_w04a_reframing: Under W04-A (reframed as independent refitting per round), the mismatch affects all Phase 5 participation rate estimates. The DR value estimates (R08-R11) and the policy contrast (R12) are computed on the evaluation scale (X_bp_pp) using weights trained on raw scale. The direction of bias is not analytically determined without rerunning; however, since Phase 5 is reframed as a policy simulation rather than a trained prediction model, the primary impact is on the internal consistency of the refitting procedure.
phase5_preprocessing_mismatch.scope: All Phase 5 BETTER-BP policy replay results (R08-R12) are affected.
phase5_preprocessing_mismatch.resolution: Documented here as W04b; manuscripts reframed under W04-A to describe policy-stratified simulation rather than a federated model trained with carryover state. Author verification recommended before submission.
